item.title: Festivity OTS
item.description:
In this article, we’ll explain what OTS is, and how to test the Festivity event.

What is OTS?

OTS stands for Open Test Server. Here, you gain access to early versions of updates.

This time, it is open for EU and RU players only.

Your task is to provide feedback to help us identify and fix issues before the final release.

On the OTS, your character will have the gear they had at the moment they were added to the testing participant list.

Progress is not transferred between servers, and everything you do with items on OTS stays there.

Participants list

Access to the OTS will be granted to a limited number of players who reached the Bar reputation level 2 and played more than 10 hours last month.

How do I know if I have access?

EXBO launcher users will see a separate server available for download — STALZONE OTS.

Steam players can check for an in-game message titled “OTS invitation”, sent by System to their most recently active character. If you don’t have this message, you are not eligible for testing.

Testing period

OTS will run from October 23, 2026, 15:00 (UTC) to October 25, 2026, 20:59 (UTC).

Please note! This is a test server. It may be stopped or restarted for changes anytime.

What we're looking for on this OTS?

We want to hear your thoughts on the mode’s gameplay, economy, and balance.

All OTS testers will have access to a survey about Festivity event.

To participate in the survey, please open your in-game mail on the test server and select the "OTS survey" message.

We are counting on your feedback. You can also discuss the event tests on our Discord server in the discussion.

Please be understanding of any issues and not finished parts. We will monitor and maintain OTS until it ends.

How to start playing on OTS?

OTS will be available to players in RU and EU regions. Steam login remains supported.

If you’re using the launcher and have access, the server will automatically appear in your download list.

To join via Steam, you need to choose the available beta version in the game settings.

Important note! In Steam, the beta version is available for download to everyone, even those who were not included on the participant list.

This could lead to a situation where you waste bandwidth downloading but are unable to participate in testing.

To avoid this, we recommend using the EXBO Launcher to log into the test server, even if you usually play through Steam.
Detailed instructions are available here.

What should you do on the OTS?

Open the ESC menu, go to the Festivity tab, and click Play to start the match.

More about the event

Festivity is a PvPvE event where a team of five players must defend their Relic — a structure located in the center of the arena.

The match is divided into rounds:

  • In the first three rounds, you’ll fight waves of mutants and NPCs;

  • In the fourth round, you’ll face a boss;

  • Every fifth round, you’ll face an opposing team. The team that deals more damage to the structure in the center of the map wins the round.

All players start the match without any gear and with 100 coins to spend in the shop (press “E”). You’ll start with low-tier armor and weapons and can upgrade your gear as the match progresses.

You’ll earn coins for completing rounds. The shop offers several armor and weapon options, as well as special Talismans with different stats.

Talismans can be combined into sets that provide additional bonuses. To complete a Talisman set, you need to use different Talismans from the same set rather than duplicates.

Besides buying gear, you can also spend coins to refresh and upgrade the shop. The higher the shop level, the more Talismans you can place in your container and the higher the chance of finding higher-tier gear.

You’ll learn more about the event while testing it. In your feedback, you can also let us know how clear or confusing you found the different game mechanics.

I found a bug, how can I report it?

Any issues discovered during testing can be reported to our Support:

https://support.exbo.games/en

For your convenience, you can also refer to the guides:

  • Creating and filing a ticket

  • Bug report of the game mechanics

  • Bug report of the game world map

  • Bug report of another kind of bug

  • Bug report of the game quest

OTS challenges and rewards

To receive rewards, complete tasks in the Open Test Challenges tab of the Event Hub.

Rewards for successfully completed challenges will be sent to the main server and credited to the appropriate characters within 30 business days after OTS ends.

Challenge

Reward

Deal 5 000 damage to the object in the center of the arena during a PvP round

• 2 Fishie Crates

• 1 000 Season Pass points

• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries

Survive 70 PvE rounds without dying

• 3 Fishie Crates

• 4 000 Season Pass points

• 5 Overloads

Win 10 PvP rounds

• 2 Fishie Crates

• 2 000 Season Pass points

• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries

Survive 15 rounds without your Relic taking any damage

• 3 Fishie Crates

• 4 000 Season Pass points

Kill 500 mutants and zombies

• 2 Fishie Crates

• 3 000 Season Pass points

• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries

Kill 20 bosses

• 3 Fishie Crates

• 4 000 Season Pass points

• 3 days of Premium

Kill 50 players from the enemy team

• 2 Fishie Crates

• 2 000 Season Pass points

• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries

Assemble 1 piece of master tier gear

• 1 Fishie Crate

• 5 Overdrives

Spend 2 000 coins in the mode

• 2 Fishie Crates

• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries

• 5 Overdrives

Conclusion

We are counting on your feedback and would greatly appreciate it if you leave it the in-game survey or on Discord in the discussion thread.

Sincerely,
EXBO Team

item.title: What’s behind the cards?
item.description:
The personal store is back!

Every stalker gets their own selection of randomly chosen discounted offers. Styles, charms, packs and more — you might just find exactly what you’ve been looking for!

Head to the personal store and see what surprises are waiting for you.

item.title: Join the Festivity on October 28!
item.description:
[carousel][/carousel]

The hour draws nigh. Soon the fears shall step out of the shadows, and the horror born of sin shall demand its due. Only a little time remains until the Festivity begins.

Until then, let the cards be read, before your eyes no longer recognize the written word.

item.title: Fuss in the Bar
item.description:
The whole Bar was turned upside down when someone started a rumor about a backpack full of loot on the grounds of the Pervomaisky Factory. Many stalkers refuse to believe that such a haul could be right under their noses.

No one paid any attention to the mysterious photograph left behind one of the tables at the bar...

Don't hesitate — get to the stash first!

item.title: Metropolite's arena
item.description: The entity assumes its final form. Praise and embrace it.

item.title: Diggers' Tales
item.description:
Diggers around the Scrapyard are spreading rumors that someone hid some loot nearby.

The only thing is, no one remembers where the photo of the attic came from...

Don’t miss your chance — find the stash!

item.title: Camera on the Zone — you in the spotlight
item.description:
The Chernobyl Exclusion Zone is full of stories worthy of the big screen: wild firefights, epic moments, and unexpected twists. What if the whole STALZONE community got to see them?

Coming soon: the #SZFRAGMENTS clip challenge! Film, edit, experiment, and turn your stories into something special!

📆 Kicking off October 28. There's still time to come up with an idea and get ready to chase those views.

item.title: Chain of Decay — Rewards!
item.description:
Today, we are rewarding everyone who actively took part in solving the mystery and completing the quest.

Initially, we planned to reward only the players who stood out within the community, as well as the first player to complete the quest. However, we have now decided to revise our approach.

In addition to the previously mentioned player categories, we have also added a reward for those who helped the first player with the completion, as well as for those who managed to collect all the tapes before 04.09.2026, 08:00 AM GMT+3.

Along with this, we have revised the rewards themselves and added a bit more uniqueness to them:

1. Reward for collecting the tapes before the quest was completed

• Audio Recorder charm;

• “Follower of the Decay” achievement.

2. Reward for active community members

• Audio Recorder charm;

• Thirty-Fifth Cockroach charm;

• “Witness of the Decay” achievement.

3. Reward for the trailblazer’s companions

• Audio Recorder charm;

• Thirty-Fifth Cockroach charm;

• Fourth Lever decor;

• “Guide of the Decay” achievement.

4. Reward for the trailblazer

• Audio Recorder charm;

• Thirty-Fifth Cockroach charm;

• Fourth Lever decor;

• “One Who Knows Decay” achievement;

• Keeper of Truth skin for the Albatross Assault.

Once again, congratulations to everyone involved in solving the mystery, especially the first player to complete the quest and their companions: BAZAROMA, Max_Cota, C_Obakevich, and MrXanter!
